<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Reset the internal backup runtime state"}
></Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/backupRuntime/state"}
  context={"endpoint"}
></MethodEndpoint>

Resets all internal backup runtime state, including the latest checkpoint info,
latest backup info, all checkpoint metadata entries, and all backup range entries.
This is an administrative operation intended for use when switching backup stores,
allowing the internal state to be cleared so it can be rebuilt against the new store.

Resets the state of every physical tenant unless `physicalTenant` narrows it to one.

<Heading id={"request"} as={"h2"} className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}>

</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[
    {
      name: "physicalTenant",
      required: false,
      in: "query",
      description:
        "Narrows the operation to the given physical tenant. When omitted, the operation covers every\nphysical tenant of the cluster, which on a single-tenant cluster is the one `default` tenant\nand therefore unchanged behavior.\n",
      schema: {
        title: "Physical Tenant ID",
        description:
          "The id of a physical tenant, as configured under `camunda.physical-tenants`. A cluster that\nconfigures none has exactly one physical tenant, `default`.\n",
        type: "string",
        example: "tenanta",
      },
    },
  ]}
></ParamsDetails>
